UPDATE jc_fund_filling_detail t1 SET t1.host_unit_id = ( SELECT u.unit_id FROM jc_fund_filling_ln a, fnd_org_unit u WHERE a.filling_ln_id = #{fillingLnId} AND substring_index(a.UNIT_CODE,'1',1) = u.UNIT_CODE ) WHERE t1.FILLING_ID = #{fillingId} AND t1.filling_ln_id = #{fillingLnId} AND t1.host_unit_id IS NULL

SELECT t.* FROM jc_fund_filling_ln t, jc_funding_plan_one n, jc_funding_plan p
t.FILL_ITEM_CODE IN ('SX_KYHA','SX_BLHA','TJ_KYHA','TJ_BLHA','SX_KYHB','SX_BLHB','TJ_KYHB','TJ_BLHB','INITIAL_BALANCE','END_BALANCE') AND t.FILL_ITEM_CODE = n.ITEM_CODE AND p.REPORT_CODE = 'JC-20200311-004' AND n.FUNDING_ID = p.FUNDING_ID
and t.filling_id = #{fillingId}
ORDER BY n.ITEM_SEQ

SELECT concat( ( CASE to_char(t.FIRST_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.FIRST_DAY ) FIRST_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.SECOND_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.SECOND_DAY ) SECOND_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.THIRD_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.THIRD_DAY ) THIRD_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.FOURTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.FOURTH_DAY ) FOURTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.FIFTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.FIFTH_DAY ) FIFTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.SIXTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.SIXTH_DAY ) SIXTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.SEVENTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.SEVENTH_DAY ) SEVENTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.EIGHTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.EIGHTH_DAY ) EIGHTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.NINTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.NINTH_DAY ) NINTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.TENTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.TENTH_DAY ) TENTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.ELEVENTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.ELEVENTH_DAY ) ELEVENTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.TWELFTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.TWELFTH_DAY ) TWELFTH_DAY, concat( ( CASE to_char(t.THIRTEENTH_DAY, 'w') WHEN 1 THEN '星期一' WHEN 2 THEN '星期二' WHEN 3 THEN '星期三' WHEN 4 THEN '星期四' WHEN 5 THEN '星期五' WHEN 6 THEN '星期六' ELSE '星期天' END ), '
', t.THIRTEENTH_DAY ) THIRTEENTH_DAY FROM jc_fund_plan_schedule t
1=1
and t.fill_year = #{fillYear}
and t.fill_mon = #{fillMon}
and t.fill_week = #{fillWeek}
and t.fill_quarter = #{fillQuarter}
